import sys, pathlib

start = pathlib.Path.cwd()
root = next(p for p in [start, *start.parents]
            if (p / "day07_09_support" / "examples" / "automation_models.py").is_file())
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "day07_09_support" / "examples"))
import automation_models as am

report = am.load_report(am.training_power_budget())
for row in report["rows"]:
    print(f"{row['name']:<16} x{row['quantity']}  {row['total_current_a']:.3f} A  {row['total_power_w']:5.2f} W")
print(f"steady total      {report['steady_total_a']:.2f} A  {report['total_power_w']:5.1f} W")
print(f"planning (+25%)   {report['planning_current_a']:.2f} A")
print("This is a training budget, not a power-supply sizing approval.")

import sys, pathlib

start = pathlib.Path.cwd()
root = next(p for p in [start, *start.parents]
            if (p / "day07_09_support" / "examples" / "automation_models.py").is_file())
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "day07_09_support" / "examples"))
import automation_models as am

for output_type in ("PNP", "NPN"):
    for common in ("0V", "+24V"):
        result = am.plc_input_compatibility(output_type, common)
        mark = "OK  " if result["compatible"] else "NG  "
        print(f"{mark}{output_type} sensor, input common {common:<4} : {result['current_path']}")
print("Check the datasheet: wire colours and terminal numbers vary by product.")

NG  NPN sensor, input common 0V   : +24V (common) -> PLC input circuit -> NPN sensor output -> 0V
OK  NPN sensor, input common +24V : +24V (common) -> PLC input circuit -> NPN sensor output -> 0V

seal-in-vs-extended.source:
import sys, pathlib

start_path = pathlib.Path.cwd()
root = next(p for p in [start_path, *start_path.parents]
            if (p / "day07_09_support" / "examples" / "automation_models.py").is_file())
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "day07_09_support" / "examples"))
import automation_models as am

basic = am.BasicSealIn()
basic.step(start=True, stop_ok=True)
basic.step(start=True, stop_ok=False)
print("basic seal-in, STOP opened while START held :", basic.step(start=True, stop_ok=True))

gate = am.StartGate()
gate.power_on()
held = gate.step(start=True)
print("extended, held START at power-up            :", held)
print("extended, START released                    :", gate.step(start=False))
print("extended, new START edge                    :", gate.step(start=True))
print("extended, STOP opened                       :", gate.step(start=True, stop_ok=False))
print("extended, permission restored, START held   :", gate.step(start=True, stop_ok=True))

import automation_models as am

drive = am.MotorInterlock()
print("forward only        :", drive.step(forward_req=True, reverse_req=False))
print("reverse only        :", drive.step(forward_req=False, reverse_req=True))
print("both at the same time:", drive.step(forward_req=True, reverse_req=True))
print("stop opened         :", drive.step(forward_req=True, reverse_req=False, stop_ok=False))
print("extend allowed      :", am.interlock_allows({"product": True, "retracted": True}, True))
print("extend refused      :", am.interlock_allows({"product": False, "retracted": True}, True))

light-budget.source:
import sys, pathlib

start = pathlib.Path.cwd()
root = next(p for p in [start, *start.parents]
            if (p / "day07_09_support" / "examples" / "automation_models.py").is_file())
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "day07_09_support" / "examples"))
import automation_models as am

speed, sampling = 1000.0, 0.125
for exposure_ms in (1.0, 0.5, 0.25, 0.125):
    exposure_s = exposure_ms / 1000.0
    blur_px = am.motion_blur_px(speed, exposure_s, sampling)
    print(f"exposure {exposure_ms:>5.3f} ms : blur {blur_px:5.1f} px, relative light {exposure_ms / 1.0:.3f}")
print("Shorter exposure limits blur but reduces the light collected.")

timing-and-decision.source:
import sys, pathlib

start_path = pathlib.Path.cwd()
root = next(p for p in [start_path, *start_path.parents]
            if (p / "day07_09_support" / "examples" / "automation_models.py").is_file())
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "day07_09_support" / "examples"))
import automation_models as am

print(f"frame interval movement at 30 FPS, 1000 mm/s : {am.frame_interval_move_mm(1000, 30):.2f} mm")
print(f"line rate for 0.125 mm/line at 1000 mm/s      : {am.line_rate_lps(1000, 0.125):.0f} lines/s")
for label, result, flags in (
    ("valid OK", "OK", {}),
    ("valid NG", "NG", {}),
    ("no image", "OK", {"image_available": False}),
    ("inference failed", "NG", {"inference_ok": False}),
    ("PLC link lost", "OK", {"communication_ok": False}),
    ("unknown result", None, {}),
):
    print(f"{label:<18} -> {am.inspection_decision(result, **flags)}")
